title: Agent Identity Relying Party Discovery v1 (agent-signup.json)
description: Identity-only v1 discovery document served at GET /.well-known/agent-signup.json. It is a parameter document, not a capability catalog: vendor capability surface (instance_catalog, endpoints.provision, endpoints.email_signup, endpoints.verify_otp, endpoints.broker_signup_receipt, SKUs/pricing/resource metadata) is forbidden and rejected. The v1.2 embedded `rp_attestation` carrier is removed and rejected; v1.3 publishes one optional `attestation` source object instead. Unknown additive identity fields and namespaced `extensions` metadata are allowed and preserved. Normative definition: agent-identity-v1.md. Kept in lockstep with `AgentSignupDiscoverySchema` in this package (Zod is the source of truth).

protocol.description: Protocol version, major-only. Any other value means the service is unsupported.

audience.description: Stable, case-sensitive service identifier placed verbatim in the assertion `aud`.

spec.description: Optional absolute URL of the versioned specification.

contact.description: Optional security/abuse/legal contact: an email address or an absolute http(s) URL.

updated_at.description: Optional ISO 8601 timestamp for human/debuggability. Not a freshness signal for ToS.

attestation.description: OPTIONAL v1.3 attestation publication source. `mode` is `broker` (the broker's stable verification route) or `provider` (a provider-hosted source document). `uri` is a stable absolute URL: HTTPS, no userinfo, no fragment; `http://localhost` / `http://127.0.0.1` is the development exception. A `broker` URI origin MUST be a trusted broker origin and appear in `issuer_allowlist`; a `provider` URI origin MUST be the discovery origin or a subdomain of it. Host binding is enforced by the validator, not by this pattern. Absence is conformant and means unverified. The source document is `{ "attestation": "<compact JWS>" }` (attestation-source.schema.json). Normative rules: agent-identity-v1.md §5.4 and §14.

mode.description: Attestation publication mode. Exactly `broker` or `provider`; there are no aliases and no compatibility mode.

uri.description: Stable absolute source URL. It is not a signed URL and carries no per-request value.

issuer_allowlist.description: Non-empty, unique list of absolute issuer origins accepted by this RP. No path, query, fragment, or wildcard.

required_scopes.description: Unique scopes the RP requires. MUST include `tos:accept` for brokered signup.

terms.description: The ToS the agent is accepting. `text` is the complete agreement; `sha256` is over its exact UTF-8 bytes.

version.description: ToS version. MUST change whenever the text changes materially.

url.description: Absolute URL (HTTPS, localhost development exception) where a human can read the same agreement.

sha256.description: Content hash of the exact UTF-8 bytes of `text`. This JSON Schema enforces only the `sha256:<64 lowercase hex>` format; digest equality with `text` is a cross-field invariant enforced by the shared Zod schema (AgentSignupDiscoverySchema) and by the conformance validator, which recomputes it.

text.description: The complete ToS text the agent is accepting, not a summary.

endpoints.description: Signup endpoints. `agent_signup` is the only v1 endpoint; removed vendor endpoints are rejected.

agent_signup.description: Absolute URL accepting POST with `Authorization: Bearer <assertion>`.

extensions.description: Optional non-capability vendor metadata keyed by reverse-DNS namespace (for example `dev.vaporcloud`). MUST NOT advertise provisioning, catalogs, SKUs, or resource endpoints.

absoluteProtocolUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL. HTTPS is required except the `http://localhost` / `http://127.0.0.1` development origins.

attestationSourceUri.description: Absolute HTTPS URL with no userinfo and no fragment (the `http://localhost` / `http://127.0.0.1` development exception applies). Query strings are allowed: the broker verification route carries `origin` and `audience`.

issuerOrigin.description: Absolute issuer origin with no path, query, fragment, or wildcard. HTTPS unless localhost development.
